result.instructions: Tools for Quinyx, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show organization groups and their units or sections."; "Review employee assignments and agreement start/end dates."; "Show planned shifts for this unit and week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Quinyx data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run quinyx_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run quinyx_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run quinyx_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. quinyx_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: quinyx_list_groups
tools.title: List organization groups (including units/sections)
tools.description: Read one bounded page of organization groups (including units/sections). Requires organization:groups:read. Returns data plus opaque pagination tokens; pass pageToken for another page, no automatic crawl. Operational allowlist excludes payroll, national IDs, private contact/health information and free-text comments.

pageToken.description: Opaque nextPageToken from a previous response; never a URL to follow.
